predictions.articleTitle: Svay Rieng vs Port FC Prediction & Match Analysis: Can McConkey's Unbeaten Hosts Contain Thai Leaders?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Project Svay Rieng to win or draw in a controlled Under 2.5 Group B contest leaning toward a 1:0 home shutout over a 1:1 stalemate.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw: Svay Rieng combine home continuity and a 0.77 decayed GA run against Port FC's leaky continental defense, while the draw covers Thai League 1 quality (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Total Goals: Combined goal lambda of 2.25 and a 60.9% Poisson probability support a low-scoring tactical battle between two zero-point Group B sides (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)

Contingency Set-Piece & Late Transition Branch: Port FC's three set-piece goals and second-half punch keep a 1:1 draw or narrow late upset alive if key forwards start fit (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Unbeaten Svay Rieng host leaky Thai League leaders Port FC.

spf.comment: Covers Svay Rieng's 1:0 home-continuity win script alongside the 1:1 draw script driven by Port FC's Thai League 1 attack and tight 0.15 lambda gap, where a single win call leaves too much exposure to a set-piece stalemate.

over_under.comment: A 2.25 combined goal lambda, 60.9% Poisson Under 2.5 share, Port FC's 50.0% big-chance waste rate, and Group B defensive caution favour under 2.5 goals.

btts.comment: Svay Rieng's 0.77 decayed goals-against form and 35.0% Poisson clean-sheet projection outweigh Port FC's 1.05 away lambda and wasteful 42.6%-possession attack.

score.comment: 1:0 represents the leading home shutout script while 1:1 captures the top Poisson cell if Port FC convert a set piece or late counter.

goals.comment: Two goals (26.7%) and one goal (23.7%) lead the Poisson total-goal distribution around a 2.25 combined goal expectancy.

bqc.comment: First-half caution between two zero-point teams points to a level interval before Svay Rieng either break through late or share a tight stalemate.
